_note: Episode 10 version 2 (the new form). Every still is one full painted picture in the Bakunawa look (JSON prompt: subject, setting, light; three draws a still, one request at a time, the choice at 3x). Writing in pictures is added in code after the choice (see WRITING.md in this folder). No still is shown twice; a sentence that continues a still holds it (shots_fx.json key).
